THE DOME AND ITS LONG CRACK: a high dome of layered blue ice, its flat bands curving over in chunky stepped pixel sides, one long white crack reaching across the dome and stopping short of the far edge
THE CRACKED BLUE DOME: a wide dome of flat blue bands bowing overhead, each band a slightly different shade, one long white crack splitting the highest point and trailing off to one side
THE LAYERED DOME: a dome of stacked blue ice, its flat bands sagging unevenly, one pane in the highest band gone lens-clear so the chamber beyond bends through it
THE DOME WITH FROST RIBS: a high blue dome of layered ice, its flat bands curving overhead with hard pixel edges, one long white crack running from the peak and bending before it stops
THE ICICLE-HUNG ROOF: the whole roof hung with icicles of very different lengths, thickest where the ceiling dips lowest, one far longer than the rest hanging alone to one side
THE ROOF AND ITS LONG ONE: icicles of uneven length covering the roof, clustered thickly at the lowest dip, one single icicle far longer than all the others hanging well apart from the cluster
THE ICICLE ROOF: the ceiling hung with icicles at wildly different lengths, a pocket of ancient air the size of a fist trapped silver against the blue between three of the thickest
THE DIPPING ICICLE CEILING: the roof hung unevenly with icicles, the longest and fattest gathered where the ceiling sags lowest on the left, one slender icicle standing far off to the right and apart
THE GLOWING THIN SHEET: a ceiling of ice thin enough that the light comes right through it and it glows pale and even, the pale shapes of clouds crossing slowly above it in soft flat bands
THE BIRD-SHADOW CEILING: a thin sheet of ice overhead glowing pale and steady, one small bird's shadow passing across it from one side, its wings spread in a clear stepped pixel silhouette
THE CLOUD-CROSSING CEILING: a thin luminous ceiling of ice with chunky stepped pixel sides at its rim, pale cloud shapes drifting above it and pressing their flat forms against the glowing sheet
THE THIN SHEET: a thin sheet of ceiling ice, pale and lamp-like where the daylight comes through it, a column of bubbles frozen in place rising to meet it
THE RAGGED ROUND OPENING: a ragged round gap high in the roof showing one band of dithered sky and five sharp pixel stars, its uneven rim catching pale light on the left side
THE PIXEL-SKY OPENING: a rough opening in the roof, wider on one side than the other, showing a strip of dithered sky above and three sharp pixel stars clustered toward the right of the gap

THE STARLIT HOLE: a jagged round opening high in the ice roof, its rim of stepped blocky shelves catching the light, a narrow band of dithered sky showing through with seven pixel stars scattered unevenly across it

THE BUBBLE VAULT: the vault overhead filled with trapped bubbles held in rising lines, each line leaning a little off-centre, the tallest line of bubbles climbing closer to the left wall than the right

THE LEAF CEILING: a scattering of golden leaves held in the ceiling ice at different depths, some near the surface and some far within, three larger leaves set apart from the main cluster toward one corner
THE SNOWFLAKE ROOF: pale snowflakes frozen mid-fall in the roof ice, each one stopped at a different height, five of them gathered in a loose arc with one drifting well away from the rest
THE SCALLOPED VAULT: a vault scalloped into rounded hollows of uneven size, the largest hollow sitting off to one side, its chunky stepped pixel edges catching the pale overhead light
THE RIBBED VAULT: heavy ribs of ice climbing into the dark above, each rib a different thickness, one rib springing higher than all the others and leaning slightly away from the rest
THE SCALLOPED RIBBED CEILING: a vault of uneven scalloped hollows crossed by three ice ribs of different heights, the tallest rib rising through the widest hollow and disappearing into the dark above
THE HIGH LEDGE WITH ROPE: a high ice ledge running along one wall, its stepped blocky shelf wider at one end than the other, one old frozen rope hanging from it in a loose uneven loop
THE LIT UPPER CHAMBER: a smaller chamber opening high in the wall on the right side, its mouth uneven and wider at the top, warm pale light pressing out from somewhere inside it

THE DARK THROAT CLIMBING AWAY: the roof narrowing into a throat of ice climbing out of sight, its rim of chunky stepped pixel sides catching pale light, its walls shading from pale blue to deep blue as it rises

THE DEEP BLUE THROAT: the ceiling drawing up into a dark throat of ice, its walls banded in flat deep blue with hard pixel edges, the rim lit on one side only where the light reaches it before the dark takes over
